assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a highly refined, detailed ink-and-watercolor editorial illustration for An AUsome Life, a preppy New England family-life journal, to accompany an article about a toy shop's thoughtful autism-friendly welcome. The attached reference is STYLE ONLY: match its fine pen linework, convincing natural perspective, detailed wood grain, luminous transparent watercolor washes and organically feathered edges. Do not reproduce the jukebox or restaurant. Scene: an imagined independent English toy-shop interior viewed from a welcoming open doorway, with honey-colored wooden shelves, beautifully made unbranded wooden toys, picture books, a little wooden train, a rocking zebra, a green-leaf indoor tree and two small hanging hot-air-balloon decorations. Leave a generous clear central browsing space, soft natural daylight, engaging details to discover, no people. Restrained palette: navy, pine green, honey wood, cream, a little cranberry and muted ochre. Grown-up magazine quality, immersive and observational, not childish clip art or a flat dollhouse diagram. This is an imaginative editorial scene, NOT an architectural rendering of My Small World or a claim about its layout. No shop names, no logos, no writing, no puzzle-piece symbols. Landscape 3:2 composition, entire vignette contained with breathing room, irregular painterly edges dissolve into genuine alpha transparency. No rectangular background, no drop shadow, no border. Preserve rich but delicate interior detail.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a refined ink-and-watercolor still-life illustration for an adult New England family-life magazine. A thoughtfully arranged small outing bag study: a classic natural canvas tote with navy handles, a pair of teal over-ear ear defenders resting beside it, a plain navy-cased tablet with its screen asleep, and a small closed unbranded picture book in muted cranberry. Arrange naturally on a barely suggested wooden bench, not as a shopping product catalog, with comfortable negative space. No people, hands, text, logos, printed symbols or medical equipment; no babyish elements. Accurate everyday proportions. The theme is having familiar communication and comfort supports close to hand. Cream canvas, pine/navy, teal, warm oak, restrained cranberry. Landscape 3:2, complete subjects uncropped, softly irregular watercolor edges fading into genuine alpha transparency. No background rectangle, no frames, no artificial shadow, no collage. Quiet, beautiful, tactile, detailed adult editorial art.
